rationale.overall: The stamp itself is rendered identically in both, so the deciding difference is the ground plane: B's diagonal keeps a textured wedge running to the lower-left corner, matching the REFERENCE's concrete/paper split and its heavier weighting toward the textured surface, whereas A lets the pale paper reach the left edge and flattens that lower-left area.
rationale.material: Volumetric shading, the translucent curl, the soft top-face gradient and the warm rim glow along the base are indistinguishable between A and B, and both read as slightly flatter and glassier than the REFERENCE's gritty stone.
rationale.silhouette: The block, curl and rounded-square boundary are pixel-for-pixel the same in both takes, giving the same clean angled read against the background.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16px the two strips are visually identical — same dark diagonal mass, same surviving orange edge, same loss of the curl into a pale smudge.
